objective: Every mechanism the dev-loop claims is exercised by a control that can fail — starting with agy_session.py's poll loop, which is implemented, shipped, and never once observed doing its job.

criteria.description: Stopping condition: sh skills/dev-loop/scripts/validate.sh && python3 tests/test_agy_session_poll.py
Working tree clean of uncommitted residue

non_goals: Do not refactor unassigned modules or out-of-scope files.
Do not introduce regressions to passing baseline tests.
Do not bypass security checks, linters, or suppressions.
